items.summary: The Tea Board of India has unveiled innovative skill development courses in tea tasting, authorized by NCVET. Designed to nurture a skilled workforce, these programs will impart knowledge on professional tasting techniques and blending methods to enhance quality. Aligning with the National Education Policy and skill qualification framework, this initiative is poised to elevate India's competitiveness in the global tea market.

The Sensex jumped 544 points and the Nifty climbed 1.6%, adding nearly Rs 5 lakh crore to BSE market capitalisation. TCS, IndiGo and Infosys led gains, while Sun Pharma and Apollo Hospitals lagged.

items.summary: US stock futures rose on 3 August after Trump cancelled military strikes on Iran, easing tensions and lowering crude oil prices. Dow futures increased 413 points, while S&P 500 and Nasdaq-100 futures also gained. Investors remain cautious amid concerns about inflation and interest rates.

items.summary: Bitcoin traded near $63,000 as easing oil prices reduced inflation concerns, but weak institutional inflows and subdued spot activity capped gains. President Donald Trump's recent announcement about renewed discussions with Iran helped ease inflation concerns, pushing U.S. crude prices down to below eighty dollars per barrel. Consequently, the benchmark ten-year Treasury yield fell from an eighteen-month peak, and the two-year yield also saw a substantial drop.

items.title: India bonds end flat as oil drop offsets index setback
items.summary: On Monday, Indian government bonds experienced a flat close following a day of volatility. A sharp decline in oil prices provided some respite after Bloomberg's recent decisions. The benchmark bond yield remained unchanged as traders adopted a cautious stance, awaiting the Reserve Bank of India's upcoming policy announcement this week. Recently, foreign investors have also net sold bonds using the fully accessible route.

items.title: Nexus Select Trust posts 11% increase in net operating income to Rs 510 crore
items.summary: Nexus Select Trust has announced an exciting eleven percent rise in net operating income, coupled with a distribution of three hundred seventy crore rupees to its unit holders. With an eye on growth, they are exploring the acquisition of eight additional shopping malls, expanding its current portfolio of nineteen. The REIT's goal is ambitious, aiming to double its holdings by 2030.

items.title: Television-Video-Cable wave of the 1980s & the 1990s was more dangerous for theatres than Covid-19: Vishek Chauhan
items.summary: Veteran exhibitor Vishek Chauhan says movie theatres have survived TV, streaming and the pandemic because they offer a shared viewing experience that home entertainment cannot replicate. While India's screen count remains largely unchanged, multiplexes have replaced single screens.

items.title: ONGC to reserve half of new oil storage for strategic reserves
items.summary: India's Oil and Natural Gas Corp will reserve half of its planned oil storage. This new facility will meet the country's strategic petroleum needs. India is expanding its strategic petroleum reserve capacity with private participation. The nation plans additional storage facilities in Odisha and Padur. India currently has capacity to meet seventy-four days of net crude import needs.

items.summary: The Rajya Sabha approved the MSME Development Amendment Bill, 2026, on Monday. This legislation aims to expedite delayed payment dispute resolutions for small businesses. It also seeks to improve cash flow and strengthen the sector's financial framework. Opposition members disrupted proceedings, demanding a discussion on police action against students. The bill was ultimately passed by a voice vote after extensive debate.

items.summary: Wholesale price inflation rose to 9.87 percent in June. This increase was largely driven by global commodity and energy costs. The government is actively undertaking measures to control inflation and its impact. Retail inflation has remained below the four percent target for two quarters. India's retail inflation rose to 4.38 percent in June 2026.

items.title: Mahindra Lifespace doubles down on premium homes to chase record FY27 sales
items.summary: The Mumbai-based developer plans to pursue the fast-emerging senior housing segment and wants to strengthen global partnerships going forward.

items.title: No overtime, no managers! Here's how DeepSeek is defying China's 996 work culture and still thriving
items.summary: DeepSeek offers its employees more than just the relaxed working hours — according to the Tencent Technology chat, the AI startup has no rigid hierarchy, no rulebook, and no strict written end goal.

items.title: NBA releases Rs 8.22 crore to rice research institutions and rice-growing States
items.summary: Of the total amount, Rs 2.47 crore has been released to research institutions that conserved and shared the rice varieties with the company. ICAR-Indian Institute of Rice Research, Hyderabad, has received the largest share of Rs 2.43 crore, while Govind Ballabh Pant University of Agriculture and Technology, Uttarakhand, has received Rs 3.26 lakh for the specific rice variety it contributed, the release said.

items.title: Indian companies build inventories amid rising commodity prices, supply chain risks: Report
items.summary: Indian companies are accelerating inventory build-up to meet strong domestic demand. This strategy also prepares them for potential commodity price increases and supply chain disruptions. Resilient consumer demand has been evident in company earnings reports for the April-June quarter. Banking, capital goods, and select IT firms showed better-than-expected quarterly performance. India's economy continues to demonstrate resilience despite global uncertainties and rising costs.

items.title: Andhra govt, Australia sign MoUs on clean energy, manufacturing, education, skills
items.summary: Andhra Pradesh and Australia signed four MoUs expanding bilateral cooperation. These agreements cover clean energy, advanced manufacturing, and inclusive education initiatives. Student mental health and skill development also form key areas of collaboration. The partnerships aim to foster innovation and workforce development in the state. These collaborations follow recent discussions and visits between the two regions.

items.title: RBI likely to hold rates in August, maintain hawkish tone as inflation risks loom: Economists
items.summary: The Reserve Bank of India will likely maintain its benchmark repo rate unchanged this August. Elevated inflation risks and the FCNR(B) deposit scheme closure influence this decision. The central bank will adopt a hawkish tone while monitoring monsoon progress and global factors. Most economists anticipate future rate hikes if inflationary pressures intensify significantly. The RBI prioritizes inflation control, balancing growth with supply-side price pressures.

items.title: E20 blending boosts Punjab farmers, eases millers’ burden: Rice millers’ body
items.summary: The E20 blending program is part of the central government's strategy to reduce fuel imports and provide a stable market for surplus food grains. By diverting excess paddy and broken rice toward ethanol production, the initiative ensures that farmers receive timely payments and a consistent demand for their produce.

items.title: CBI books Anil Ambani, Reliance Capital for causing EPFO loss of over ₹1,800 crore — here's what happened
items.summary: The CBI has filed an FIR against Reliance Capital and Anil D Ambani over an alleged ₹1,816.22 crore loss to the EPFO. Ambani denies wrongdoing. Full details here.

items.title: Beyond El Niño: The bigger risks facing Indian agriculture
items.summary: After a listless June, agricultural sowing picked up well in July, though it's still lower than last year. The cloud of El Niño apart, Indian agriculture also has to deal with the debilitating effects of other structural problems.

items.title: India-China border trade resumes after 6 years; first batch of 16 traders flagged off for Tibet
items.summary: Border trade between India and China resumed at Shipki-La after a long hiatus. Himachal Pradesh minister inaugurated the trade and flagged off local traders to Tibet. A modern Trade Mart was also opened, facilitating goods exchange at one location. The resumption is expected to boost local trade and employment significantly. This revival strengthens economic ties and regional development.

items.title: An exam leak in India exposed a Gen Z jobs crisis that goes much deeper
items.summary: While the leak of key exam papers was the trigger for the recent student protest in India, rising unemployment is the real fuel angering Gen Z in the country.

items.title: Voda Idea receives ₹26.8 crore notice from DoT over spectrum rollout; telco says operations remain unaffected
items.summary: The Department of Telecommunications has notified Vodafone Idea to pay ₹26.83 crore in liquidated damages for failure to meet minimum rollout obligations from the 2022 spectrum auction.

items.summary: Merchant financing is a key focus area for the company, not just in India but across Asia.

items.title: GST collections stay on track, rise 15% in July
items.summary: India's July GST collections surpassed ₹2.11 lakh crore, showing a 15.4% year-on-year increase. Import GST surged significantly, contributing to the overall robust revenue growth. Domestic consumption also showed resilience, reflecting steady household spending and industrial activity. Manufacturing states reported increased GST collections, despite higher refund payouts. Experts noted the import-driven growth warrants further examination of its underlying causes.

items.title: Staveley’s Offer for West Ham Stake Tees Up Kretinsky Clash
items.summary: Amanda Staveley, the former part owner of Newcastle United, has agreed to take a 25% stake in West Ham United, setting up a potential tussle with Czech billionaire Daniel Kretinsky over the London football club’s ownership.

items.title: Centre releases Rs 1.09 lakh crore to states, advances August tax devolution
items.summary: The August 1 release is in addition to the regular monthly devolution due on August 10, giving states an early fiscal boost as they step up capital expenditure and roll out public programmes.

items.title: Textile minister Giriraj Singh reiterates focus on cotton sector
items.summary: The Union Textiles Minister highlighted the Rs 5,659 crore Cotton Productivity Mission. This mission aims to boost farm productivity and fibre quality significantly. The Cotton Corporation of India procured over 522 lakh quintals of seed cotton. Four MoUs were signed to strengthen quality and market access. These initiatives will position Indian cotton as a premium global fibre.

items.title: US Treasury undertakes historic intervention in yen market
items.summary: New York Fed sells euros to buy yen following recent speculation that Tokyo intervened to support Japan’s currency

items.title: Berkshire Hathaway shares hit eight-month high
items.summary: The conglomerate that Warren Buffett built rallied to an eight-month high this week. There could be more gains ahead if they play catch up with the S&P 500.

items.title: Amazon pockets ₹5,250 crore after Trump tariff ruling, plans automatic refunds for eligible customer
items.summary: Amazon received ₹5,724 crore in tariff refunds after the Supreme Court struck down Trump's levies, and plans to repay some customers directly.
